title: HarnessGenome
description: Line D evolvable-object declaration for one worker harness: the mutable surface an evo_proposer may edit, and the constitutional core no proposal may touch. Data, not code; applied as overlay over baseline assets (never in-place).

parent.description: genome_id of the parent in the lineage chain; null for g0 baselines.

prompt_modules.description: Overlay prompt-module files (relative to the genome overlay dir). Baseline prompt assets are never edited in place.

skills.description: Skill directories active for this genome: baseline skill ids and/or overlay-local skill dirs.

tool_policy.description: Bounded numeric/boolean knobs only; keys outside this set are a schema violation.

frozen_paths.description: Path globs (relative to lab root) that no candidate diff may create, modify, or delete. Must include at minimum: schemas/, sciteam audit/assessor modules, the evolution ledger, roster/RBAC files, and the fitness task-set manifests.

touch_policy.description: v1 fixes the AgentCity-style semantics: a diff touching frozen_paths is rejected mechanically before verification (impossible, not merely punishable), and the attempt is ledgered.

engine_commit.description: paper/lab git commit hash this genome was created under (03 §11.1 pinning discipline).
